verses.ar: وَأَقَامُوا ثَلَاثَ سِنِينَ بِدُونِ حَرْبٍ بَيْنَ أَرَامَ وَإِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
verses.web: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلسَّنَةِ ٱلثَّالِثَةِ نَزَلَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ مَلِكُ يَهُوذَا إِلَى مَلِكِ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.web: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ لِعَبِيدِهِ: «أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ رَامُوتَ جِلْعَادَ لَنَا وَنَحْنُ سَاكِتُونَ عَنْ أَخْذِهَا مِنْ يَدِ مَلِكِ أَرَامَ؟»
verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead [is] ours, and we [be] still, [and] take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
verses.web: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لِيَهُوشَافَاطَ: «أَتَذْهَبُ مَعِي لِلْحَرْبِ إِلَى رَامُوتَ جِلْعَادَ؟» فَقَالَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ لِمَلِكِ إِسْرَائِيلَ: «مَثَلِي مَثَلُكَ. شَعْبِي كَشَعْبِكَ، وَخَيْلِي كَخَيْلِكَ».
verses.kjv: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I [am] as thou [art], my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
verses.web: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ لِمَلِكِ إِسْرَائِيلَ: «ٱسْأَلِ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَنْ كَلَامِ ٱلرَّبِّ».
verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
verses.web: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

verses.ar: فَجَمَعَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ ٱلْأَنْبِيَاءَ، نَحْوَ أَرْبَعِ مِئَةِ رَجُلٍ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «أَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى رَامُوتَ جِلْعَادَ لِلْقِتَالِ أَمْ أَمْتَنِعُ؟» فَقَالُوا: «ٱصْعَدْ فَيَدْفَعَهَا ٱلسَّيِّدُ لِيَدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ».
verses.kjv: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver [it] into the hand of the king.
verses.web: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ: «أَمَا يُوجَدُ هُنَا بَعْدُ نَبِيٌّ لِلرَّبِّ فَنَسْأَلَ مِنْهُ؟»
verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said, [Is there] not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.web: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ لِيَهُوشَافَاطَ: «إِنَّهُ يُوجَدُ بَعْدُ رَجُلٌ وَاحِدٌ لِسُؤَالِ ٱلرَّبِّ بِهِ، وَلَكِنِّي أُبْغِضُهُ لِأَنَّهُ لَا يَتَنَبَّأُ عَلَيَّ خَيْرًا بَلْ شَرًّا، وَهُوَ مِيخَا بْنُ يَمْلَةَ». فَقَالَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ: «لَا يَقُلِ ٱلْمَلِكُ هَكَذَا».
verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, [There is] yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.web: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

verses.ar: فَدَعَا مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ خَصِيًّا وَقَالَ: «أَسْرِعْ إِلَيَّ بِمِيخَا بْنِ يَمْلَةَ».
verses.kjv: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten [hither] Micaiah the son of Imlah.
verses.web: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

verses.ar: وَكَانَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ وَيَهُوشَافَاطُ مَلِكُ يَهُوذَا جَالِسَيْنِ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ، لَابِسَيْنِ ثِيَابَهُمَا فِي سَاحَةٍ عِنْدَ مَدْخَلِ بَابِ ٱلسَّامِرَةِ، وَجَمِيعُ ٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ يَتَنَبَّأُونَ أَمَامَهُمَا.
verses.kjv: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.web: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

verses.ar: وَعَمِلَ صِدْقِيَّا بْنُ كَنْعَنَةَ لِنَفْسِهِ قَرْنَيْ حَدِيدٍ وَقَالَ: «هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ: بِهَذِهِ تَنْطَحُ ٱلْأَرَامِيِّينَ حَتَّى يَفْنَوْا».
verses.kjv: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
verses.web: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

verses.ar: وَتَنَبَّأَ جَمِيعُ ٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ هَكَذَا قَائِلِينَ: «ٱصْعَدْ إِلَى رَامُوتَ جِلْعَادَ وَأَفْلِحْ، فَيَدْفَعَهَا ٱلرَّبُّ لِيَدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ».
verses.kjv: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver [it] into the king’s hand.
verses.web: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلرَّسُولُ ٱلَّذِي ذَهَبَ لِيَدْعُوَ مِيخَا فَكَلَّمَهُ قَائِلًا: «هُوَذَا كَلَامُ جَمِيعِ ٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ بِفَمٍ وَاحِدٍ خَيْرٌ لِلْمَلِكِ، فَلْيَكُنْ كَلَامُكَ مِثْلَ كَلَامِ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ، وَتَكَلَّمْ بِخَيْرٍ».
verses.kjv: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets [declare] good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak [that which is] good.
verses.web: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ مِيخَا: «حَيٌّ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ، إِنَّ مَا يَقُولُهُ لِيَ ٱلرَّبُّ بِهِ أَتَكَلَّمُ».
verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, [As] the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
verses.web: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا أَتَى إِلَى ٱلْمَلِكِ قَالَ لَهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ: «يَا مِيخَا، أَنَصْعَدُ إِلَى رَامُوتَ جِلْعَادَ لِلْقِتَالِ، أَمْ نَمْتَنِعُ؟» فَقَالَ لَهُ: «ٱصْعَدْ وَأَفْلِحْ فَيَدْفَعَهَا ٱلرَّبُّ لِيَدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ».
verses.kjv: ¶ So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver [it] into the hand of the king.
verses.web: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ: «كَمْ مَرَّةٍ ٱسْتَحْلَفْتُكَ أَنْ لَا تَقُولَ لِي إِلَّا ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ».
verses.kjv: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but [that which is] true in the name of the LORD?
verses.web: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ كُلَّ إِسْرَائِيلَ مُشَتَّتِينَ عَلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَخِرَافٍ لَا رَاعِيَ لَهَا. فَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ: لَيْسَ لِهَؤُلَاءِ أَصْحَابٌ، فَلْيَرْجِعُوا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ بِسَلَامٍ».
verses.kjv: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
verses.web: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ لِيَهُوشَافَاطَ: «أَمَا قُلْتُ لَكَ إِنَّهُ لَا يَتَنَبَّأُ عَلَيَّ خَيْرًا بَلْ شَرًّا؟»
verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
verses.web: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ: «فَٱسْمَعْ إِذًا كَلَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ: قَدْ رَأَيْتُ ٱلرَّبَّ جَالِسًا عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ، وَكُلُّ جُنْدِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ وُقُوفٌ لَدَيْهِ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ.
verses.kjv: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
verses.web: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ: مَنْ يُغْوِي أَخْآبَ فَيَصْعَدَ وَيَسْقُطَ فِي رَامُوتَ جِلْعَادَ؟ فَقَالَ هَذَا هَكَذَا، وَقَالَ ذَاكَ هَكَذَا.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
verses.web: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ خَرَجَ ٱلرُّوحُ وَوَقَفَ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ وَقَالَ: أَنَا أُغْوِيهِ. وَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ: بِمَاذَا؟
verses.kjv: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
verses.web: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

verses.ar: فَقَالَ: أَخْرُجُ وَأَكُونُ رُوحَ كَذِبٍ فِي أَفْوَاهِ جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِهِ. فَقَالَ: إِنَّكَ تُغْوِيهِ وَتَقْتَدِرُ، فَٱخْرُجْ وَٱفْعَلْ هَكَذَا.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade [him], and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
verses.web: Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’

verses.ar: وَٱلْآنَ هُوَذَا قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱلرَّبُّ رُوحَ كَذِبٍ فِي أَفْوَاهِ جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ هَؤُلَاءِ، وَٱلرَّبُّ تَكَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ بِشَرٍّ».
verses.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
verses.web: Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

verses.ar: فَتَقَدَّمَ صِدْقِيَّا بْنُ كَنْعَنَةَ وَضَرَبَ مِيخَا عَلَى ٱلْفَكِّ وَقَالَ: «مِنْ أَيْنَ عَبَرَ رُوحُ ٱلرَّبِّ مِنِّي لِيُكَلِّمَكَ؟»
verses.kjv: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
verses.web: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ مِيخَا: «إِنَّكَ سَتَرَى فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلَّذِي تَدْخُلُ فِيهِ مِنْ مِخْدَعٍ إِلَى مِخْدَعٍ لِتَخْتَبِئَ».
verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.web: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ: «خُذْ مِيخَا وَرُدَّهُ إِلَى آمُونَ رَئِيسِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ، وَإِلَى يُوآشَ ٱبْنِ ٱلْمَلِكِ،
verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
verses.web: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

verses.ar: وَقُلْ هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ: ضَعُوا هَذَا فِي ٱلسِّجْنِ، وَأَطْعِمُوهُ خُبْزَ ٱلضِّيقِ وَمَاءَ ٱلضِّيقِ حَتَّى آتِيَ بِسَلَامٍ».
verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this [fellow] in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
verses.web: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ مِيخَا: «إِنْ رَجَعْتَ بِسَلَامٍ فَلَمْ يَتَكَلَّمِ ٱلرَّبُّ بِي». وَقَالَ: «ٱسْمَعُوا أَيُّهَا ٱلشَّعْبُ أَجْمَعُونَ».
verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
verses.web: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

verses.ar: فَصَعِدَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ وَيَهُوشَافَاطُ مَلِكُ يَهُوذَا إِلَى رَامُوتَ جِلْعَادَ.
verses.kjv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.web: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ لِيَهُوشَافَاطَ: «إِنِّي أَتَنَكَّرُ وَأَدْخُلُ ٱلْحَرْبَ، وَأَمَّا أَنْتَ فَٱلْبَسْ ثِيَابَكَ». فَتَنَكَّرَ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ وَدَخَلَ ٱلْحَرْبَ.
verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
verses.web: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

verses.ar: وَأَمَرَ مَلِكُ أَرَامَ رُؤَسَاءَ ٱلْمَرْكَبَاتِ ٱلَّتِي لَهُ، ٱلِٱثْنَيْنِ وَٱلثَّلَاثِينَ، وَقَالَ: «لَا تُحَارِبُوا صَغِيرًا وَلَا كَبِيرًا إِلَّا مَلِكَ إِسْرَائِيلَ وَحْدَهُ».
verses.kjv: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
verses.web: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَى رُؤَسَاءُ ٱلْمَرْكَبَاتِ يَهُوشَافَاطَ، قَالُوا: «إِنَّهُ مَلِكُ إِسْرَائِيلَ» فَمَالُوا عَلَيْهِ لِيُقَاتِلُوهُ، فَصَرَخَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it [is] the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.web: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَى رُؤَسَاءُ ٱلْمَرْكَبَاتِ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ مَلِكَ إِسْرَائِيلَ رَجَعُوا عَنْهُ.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it [was] not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.web: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَجُلًا نَزَعَ فِي قَوْسِهِ غَيْرَ مُتَعَمِّدٍ وَضَرَبَ مَلِكَ إِسْرَائِيلَ بَيْنَ أَوْصَالِ ٱلدِّرْعِ. فَقَالَ لِمُدِيرِ مَرْكَبَتِهِ: «رُدَّ يَدَكَ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مِنَ ٱلْجَيْشِ لِأَنِّي قَدْ جُرِحْتُ».
verses.kjv: And a [certain] man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.web: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

verses.ar: وَٱشْتَدَّ ٱلْقِتَالُ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ، وَأُوقِفَ ٱلْمَلِكُ فِي مَرْكَبَتِهِ مُقَابِلَ أَرَامَ، وَمَاتَ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَسَاءِ، وَجَرَى دَمُ ٱلْجُرْحِ إِلَى حِضْنِ ٱلْمَرْكَبَةِ.
verses.kjv: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
verses.web: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

verses.ar: وَعَبَرَتِ ٱلرَّنَّةُ فِي ٱلْجُنْدِ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِ ٱلشَّمْسِ قَائِلًا: «كُلُّ رَجُلٍ إِلَى مَدِينَتِهِ، وَكُلُّ رَجُلٍ إِلَى أَرْضِهِ».
verses.kjv: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
verses.web: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

verses.ar: فَمَاتَ ٱلْمَلِكُ وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلسَّامِرَةَ فَدَفَنُوا ٱلْمَلِكَ فِي ٱلسَّامِرَةِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.web: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

verses.ar: وَغُسِلَتِ ٱلْمَرْكَبَةُ فِي بِرْكَةِ ٱلسَّامِرَةِ فَلَحَسَتِ ٱلْكِلَابُ دَمَهُ، وَغَسَلُوا سِلَاحَهُ. حَسَبَ كَلَامِ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلَّذِي تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: And [one] washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.
verses.web: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke.

verses.ar: وَبَقِيَّةُ أُمُورِ أَخْآبَ وَكُلُّ مَا فَعَلَ، وَبَيْتُ ٱلْعَاجِ ٱلَّذِي بَنَاهُ، وَكُلُّ ٱلْمُدُنِ ٱلَّتِي بَنَاهَا، أَمَا هِيَ مَكْتُوبَةٌ فِي سِفْرِ أَخْبَارِ ٱلْأَيَّامِ لِمُلُوكِ إِسْرَائِيلَ؟
verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.web: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.ar: فَٱضْطَجَعَ أَخْآبُ مَعَ آبَائِهِ، وَمَلَكَ أَخَزْيَا ٱبْنُهُ عِوَضًا عَنْهُ.
verses.kjv: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.web: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

verses.ar: وَمَلَكَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ بْنُ آسَا عَلَى يَهُوذَا فِي ٱلسَّنَةِ ٱلرَّابِعَةِ لِأَخْآبَ مَلِكِ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.web: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ ٱبْنَ خَمْسٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً حِينَ مَلَكَ، وَمَلَكَ خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ، وَٱسْمُ أُمِّهِ عَزُوبَةُ بِنْتُ شَلْحِي.
verses.kjv: Jehoshaphat [was] thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name [was] Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.web: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.ar: وَسَارَ فِي كُلِّ طَرِيقِ آسَا أَبِيهِ. لَمْ يَحِدْ عَنْهَا، إِذْ عَمِلَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ فِي عَيْنَيِ ٱلرَّبِّ. إِلَّا أَنَّ ٱلْمُرْتَفَعَاتِ لَمْ تُنْتَزِعْ، بَلْ كَانَ ٱلشَّعْبُ لَا يَزَالُ يَذْبَحُ وَيُوقِدُ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْتَفَعَاتِ.
verses.kjv: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing [that which was] right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; [for] the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
verses.web: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

verses.ar: وَصَالَحَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ مَلِكَ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.web: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

verses.ar: وَبَقِيَّةُ أُمُورِ يَهُوشَافَاطَ وَجَبَرُوتُهُ ٱلَّذِي أَظْهَرَهُ، وَكَيْفَ حَارَبَ، أَمَاهِيَ مَكْتُوبَةٌ فِي سِفْرِ أَخْبَارِ ٱلْأَيَّامِ لِمُلُوكِ يَهُوذَا؟
verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.web: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.ar: وَبَقِيَّةُ ٱلْمَأْبُونِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ بَقُوا فِي أَيَّامِ آسَا أَبِيهِ أَبَادَهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
verses.web: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.

verses.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِي أَدُومَ مَلِكٌ. مَلَكَ وَكِيلٌ.
verses.kjv: [There was] then no king in Edom: a deputy [was] king.
verses.web: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.

verses.ar: وَعَمِلَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ سُفُنَ تَرْشِيشَ لِكَيْ تَذْهَبَ إِلَى أُوفِيرَ لِأَجْلِ ٱلذَّهَبِ، فَلَمْ تَذْهَبْ، لِأَنَّ ٱلسُّفُنَ تَكَسَّرَتْ فِي عِصْيُونَ جَابِرَ.
verses.kjv: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.
verses.web: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ قَالَ أَخَزْيَا بْنُ أَخْآبَ لِيَهُوشَافَاطَ: «لِيَذْهَبْ عَبِيدِي مَعَ عَبِيدِكَ فِي ٱلسُّفُنِ». فَلَمْ يَشَأْ يَهُوشَافَاطُ.
verses.kjv: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.web: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

verses.ar: وَٱضْطَجَعَ يَهُوشَافَاطُ مَعَ آبَائِهِ، وَدُفِنَ مَعَ آبَائِهِ فِي مَدِينَةِ دَاوُدَ أَبِيهِ، فَمَلَكَ يَهُورَامُ ٱبْنُهُ عِوَضًا عَنْهُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.web: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

verses.ar: أَخَزْيَا بْنُ أَخْآبَ مَلَكَ عَلَى إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي ٱلسَّامِرَةِ فِي ٱلسَّنَةِ ٱلسَّابِعَةَ عَشْرَةَ لِيَهُوشَافَاطَ مَلِكِ يَهُوذَا. مَلَكَ عَلَى إِسْرَائِيلَ سَنَتَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
verses.web: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

verses.ar: وَعَمِلَ ٱلشَّرَّ فِي عَيْنَيِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَسَارَ فِي طَرِيقِ أَبِيهِ وَطَرِيقِ أُمِّهِ، وَطَرِيقِ يَرُبْعَامَ بْنِ نَبَاطَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ إِسْرَائِيلَ يُخْطِئُ،
verses.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
verses.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

verses.ar: وَعَبَدَ ٱلْبَعْلَ وَسَجَدَ لَهُ وَأَغَاظَ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَ إِسْرَائِيلَ، حَسَبَ كُلِّ مَا فَعَلَ أَبُوهُ.
verses.kjv: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
verses.web: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.
